"""Source-bound synthetic independent review runner; never runs scientific work."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
name = sys.argv[1]
if not name.replace('-', '').isalnum():
    raise ValueError('invalid evidence name')
prefix = HERE / name
if prefix.with_suffix('.json').exists():
    raise FileExistsError(prefix)
files = sorted(HERE.glob('test_archive*review.py')) + [HERE / 'controlled_worker_child.py', Path(__file__),
    HERE.parent / 'scripts/mpea_archive_run.py', HERE.parent / 'scripts/mpea_archive_worker.py',
    ROOT / 'scripts/mpea_study_supervisor.py', ROOT / 'scripts/mpea_stage_store.py',
    ROOT / 'scripts/mpea_study_report.py', HERE.parent / 'scripts/mpea_production_store.py',
    ROOT / 'scripts/mpea_study.py', ROOT / 'scripts/mpea_target_custody.py', ROOT / 'scripts/mpea_features.py',
    ROOT / 'tests/test_mpea_study.py', ROOT / 'tests/test_mpea_study_report.py',
    HERE.parent / 'archive-driver-contract.md', ROOT / 'docs/mpea-t25-archival-protocol-v1.md',
    ROOT / 'docs/mpea-t25-implementation-contract-v1.md', ROOT / 'docs/mpea-t25-operational-enforcement-v1.md']
files += [ROOT / ('src/lupine_discovery/' + name + '.py') for name in
          ('__init__', 'decision_pool', 'representation', 'core', 'evidence', 'serialization', 'replay')]
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(path) for path in files}
for path in files:
    if path.name in ('mpea_archive_run.py', 'mpea_archive_worker.py'):
        with (HERE / (name + '-' + path.name)).open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write(path.read_bytes())
command = [sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', str(HERE), '-p', 'test_archive*review.py', '-v']
env = {**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'LAUNCHER_REVIEW_CAPTURE': str(HERE / (name + '-captured'))}
start = time.monotonic()
try:
    run = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=300, env=env)
    out, err, code = run.stdout, run.stderr, run.returncode
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
    out, err, code = exc.stdout or b'', exc.stderr or b'', None
for suffix, raw in [('stdout.txt', out), ('stderr.txt', err)]:
    with (HERE / (name + '.' + suffix)).open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
after = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(path) for path in files}
receipt = {'schema': 'launcher.independent.execution.v1', 'command': command,
    'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'returncode': code,
    'source_before': before, 'source_after': after, 'source_unchanged': before == after,
    'stdout_sha256': sha(HERE / (name + '.stdout.txt')), 'stderr_sha256': sha(HERE / (name + '.stderr.txt')),
    'scope': 'constructed dependencies; actual supervisor user/network namespaces; no actual scientific data, registration, allocation entropy or live CI'}
with prefix.with_suffix('.json').open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(receipt, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'returncode': code, 'source_unchanged': before == after}))
print(err.decode(errors='replace'))
